name: Tittivillus Teaches Typning
storyline: A hapless monk in a medieval cathedral finds he has made too many errors on his manuscript. Praying for help, he is greeted by the titular Tittivillus, patron demon of typos, who grants the monk a wondrous machine from the future to make manuscripts quickly. Now, is this entity actually helping, or is it too late to tell the monk that printers won't be invented for 500 years?
summary: Type words as they appear. Any typos you make will go into the "shame bag". If the shame bag fills up, the abbot will wake up, and you lose! But don't worry, Titivillus, the demon of typos and mistakes, is here to "hlep!" He'll take the typos from the shame bag and add them to the words you need to type. Po Nroblem!
